tooltip.faded_pearl.resonating_anchor.ho: Placing the anchor sets your Fade's home.
tooltip.faded_pearl.resonating_anchor.re: Use it to recall him from within the same dimension.
tooltip.faded_pearl.resonating_anchor.di: It cannot pull him across dimensions.
tooltip.faded_pearl.empty_pearl: Cold and weightless. Perhaps it can be filled with water.
tooltip.faded_pearl.water_filled_pearl: The water moves inside like a faint heartbeat.
tooltip.faded_pearl.water_filled_pearl.h: Combine it with a small flower at a crafting table.
tooltip.faded_pearl.pulsating_pearl: Living energy is searching for its owner.
tooltip.faded_pearl.pulsating_pearl.hint: Offer it to the wounded Fade.
tooltip.faded_pearl.escape_pearl: Permanently protects a Fade from his owner's strikes.
tooltip.faded_pearl.escape_pearl.use: Give it once. Your strikes deal no damage or trust loss; he attempts to evade 8–16 blocks.
message.faded_pearl.escape_pearl.armed: The Fade accepted the Evasion Pearl. Its protection will remain with him.
message.faded_pearl.escape_pearl.already: This Fade is already permanently protected by an Evasion Pearl.
message.faded_pearl.escape_pearl.trigger: The Evasion Pearl protected the Fade from the strike.
dialogue.faded_pearl.first_meeting: Take it... that's why you came here, isn't it?
dialogue.faded_pearl.healed: Thank you...! I feel... wonderful! May I come with you?
dialogue.faded_pearl.command.rest: Can we rest for a while?
dialogue.faded_pearl.recovered: I'm all right... You came back for me.
dialogue.faded_pearl.carry.picked_up: I've got you. Hold on to me.
dialogue.faded_pearl.hug: May I stay like this a little longer?
dialogue.faded_pearl.affection: The world is quieter beside you.
dialogue.faded_pearl.trust.distant: ...I still don't know if I should.
dialogue.faded_pearl.trust.learning: I don't move away anymore, see?
dialogue.faded_pearl.rescued_lava: I won't let the fire take you.
dialogue.faded_pearl.rescued_health: You're hurt. I'm taking you away.
message.faded_pearl.anchor.recalled: The anchor answers with a familiar pulse.
message.faded_pearl.anchor.other_dimensi: The bond reaches another dimension, but the anchor cannot pull him through.
message.faded_pearl.companion.already_re: Another Faded Enderman is already bound to this world.
message.faded_pearl.anchor.no_home: He does not yet have a place to call home.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.flower_seen: That colour... it looks like light trapped inside petals.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.container: Humans hide so many things. Are you afraid the world will take them?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.fire: Fire is like water. Beautiful until it touches the heart.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.water: I still dislike it... but beside you I can look at it.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.ore: It glows beneath the stone. Can you hear it trembling?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.crafting: You can make something entirely new from such small things.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.cave: Caves are not empty. They simply speak very slowly.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.stars: Are stars pearls too? Just too far away to hear?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.rain: I like the sound of rain when it cannot reach us.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.animal: It is small... and it isn't afraid of me.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.villager: They speak without words. A little like we once did.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.held_item: What is that? May I look closer?
dialogue.faded_pearl.item_curiosity: Thank you. I have never seen it this closely before.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.cautious_2: I don't know this place yet.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.learning_1: Your world has more colours than I remembered.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.learning_2: Will you show me what this is for?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.learning_3: I'm trying to understand why this matters to you.
subtitles.faded_pearl.faded_enderman_cav: Wounded Faded Enderman cries in the cave
faded_pearl.dialogue.downed.recovered: The world trembles... but I can hear your footsteps.
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.jump_low: Why do you do that to the air?
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.jump_high: Is that how you show joy?
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.crouch_low: Are you hiding from something? From me?
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.crouch_high: I am here. Your eyes are so close now.
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.stare_low: ...Don't look like that. It reminds me of the old rules.
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.stare_high: I could stand here and look into your eyes forever.
faded_pearl.dialogue.weather.rain_roof: Can you hear it striking the roof? It cannot touch us here.
faded_pearl.dialogue.weather.snow: Cold white flecks... falling so slowly. They do not burn like water.
faded_pearl.dialogue.healed.0: Thank you... I can feel the world again.
faded_pearl.dialogue.healed.1: The pain is quiet. You found me.
faded_pearl.dialogue.healed.2: Your light stayed inside me. May I follow you?
faded_pearl.dialogue.flower.1: Every petal holds a slightly different colour.
faded_pearl.dialogue.carry.0: I have you. Hold on to me.
faded_pearl.dialogue.carry.2: You are safe in my arms.
faded_pearl.dialogue.downed.recovered.0: The world trembles... but I can hear your footsteps.
faded_pearl.dialogue.downed.recovered.1: You came back for me... so I will stand again.
faded_pearl.dialogue.downed.recovered.2: Your hand reminded me that I am not alone.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.hesitate.1: I am not running. Just... wait.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.hesitate.2: Your hand is warm. That is strange.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.learning.0: I do not move away anymore, see?
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.learning.1: I think I am beginning to understand this gesture.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.learning.2: You may stay a little closer.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.devotion.0: May I stay like this a little longer?
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.devotion.1: You do not have to let me go.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.devotion.2: Here beside you, I am not afraid.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.trust.2: The wound no longer screams when you are close.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.affection.0: The world is quieter beside you.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.affection.1: I know the rhythm of your footsteps now.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.affection.2: I am glad you are close again.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.gentle.1: We do not have to say anything.
faded_pearl.dialogue.touch.gentle.2: Let us stay like this for a moment.
dialogue.faded_pearl.stranger.neutral.0: I do not know you... but I hear you.
dialogue.faded_pearl.stranger.neutral.1: My choice belongs with someone else.
dialogue.faded_pearl.stranger.neutral.2: You may stay. Do not command me.
dialogue.faded_pearl.fade.meeting.0: He escaped her voice as well.
dialogue.faded_pearl.fade.meeting.1: I did not think I would meet another Fade.
dialogue.faded_pearl.fade.meeting.2: His light sounds different from mine.
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.jump_low.0: Why do you do that to the air?
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.jump_low.1: Is the ground pushing you away?
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.jump_low.2: Why do you keep escaping from it?
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.jump_high.0: Is that how you show joy?
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.jump_high.1: You have so much energy today.
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.jump_high.2: Soon you will learn to teleport.
Are you hiding from something? From me?
Why are you trying to become smaller?
I can see you even when you bend down.
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.crouch_high: I am here. Your eyes are so close now.
It is easier to meet your eyes like this.
You do not need to bend down. I can hear you.
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.stare_low.0: ...Do not look like that. It recalls the old rules.
faded_pearl.dialogue.gesture.stare_low.2: A gaze like that once meant pain.
I could look into your eyes forever.
There is no command in your eyes. Only quiet.
I am no longer afraid when you look at me.
faded_pearl.dialogue.weather.rain_roof.0: Can you hear it striking the roof? It cannot touch us here.
faded_pearl.dialogue.weather.rain_roof.1: Beneath this roof, rain is only a sound.
faded_pearl.dialogue.weather.rain_roof.2: I am glad you are waiting out the rain with me.
faded_pearl.dialogue.weather.snow.0: Cold white flecks... they do not burn like water.
faded_pearl.dialogue.weather.snow.1: Snow vanishes before I can understand it.
faded_pearl.dialogue.weather.snow.2: It falls so quietly. Almost like light.
faded_pearl.dialogue.rescue.lava.0: I will not let the fire take you.
faded_pearl.dialogue.rescue.lava.1: It is all right. The fire cannot reach us now.
faded_pearl.dialogue.rescue.lava.2: Hold on to me. I am taking us away.
faded_pearl.dialogue.rescue.health.0: You are hurt. I am taking you away.
faded_pearl.dialogue.rescue.health.1: Your heart is weakening. We are going home.
faded_pearl.dialogue.rescue.health.2: You will not fight alone. Not now.
faded_pearl.dialogue.rescue.fall.1: I will not let you fall.
faded_pearl.dialogue.rescue.fall.2: The ground will not take you today.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.flower_seen.0: That colour... it looks like light trapped inside petals.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.flower_seen.1: Flowers keep their colours even when the sky grows dark.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.flower_seen.2: Such a small thing, yet it changes the whole place.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.flower_seen.3: Do you think it remembers the sun?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.flower_seen.4: I understand why you stop to look at them.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.container.0: Humans hide so many things. Are you afraid the world will take them?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.container.1: You give every object a little place of its own.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.container.2: Is this where your important things sleep?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.container.3: There are more secrets in your boxes than in the End.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.container.4: I will not open it. I am only wondering.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.fire.0: Fire is like water. Beautiful until it touches the heart.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.fire.1: It dances as if it were alive... but it does not care whom it hurts.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.fire.2: Stay back. I know how quickly warmth becomes pain.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.fire.3: Your world makes light from things that consume.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.fire.4: I prefer the light inside my pearl. It is kinder.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.water.0: I still dislike it... but beside you I can look at it.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.water.1: It looks peaceful from here. It never feels peaceful.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.water.2: You cross it so easily. I wish I understood how.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.water.3: Please do not ask me to follow you through that.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.water.4: I trust you. I do not trust the water.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.ore.0: It glows beneath the stone. Can you hear it trembling?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.ore.1: The earth hid something bright here.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.ore.2: You saw it before I did. Your eyes are good at finding treasure.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.ore.3: Will it become something new in your hands?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.ore.4: Stone keeps its colours deeper than flowers do.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.crafting.0: You can make something entirely new from little things.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.crafting.1: Your hands always seem to know what comes next.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.crafting.2: Nothing in the End was ever assembled so carefully.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.crafting.3: May I watch? I will keep my hands away.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.crafting.4: You turn a collection of pieces into an answer.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.cave.0: Caves are not empty. They simply speak very slowly.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.cave.1: The stone makes every quiet sound feel important.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.cave.2: It is dark, but not the same darkness as home.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.cave.3: Your footsteps come back to us from the walls.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.cave.4: Stay near. This place has too many directions.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.stars.0: Are stars pearls too? Just too far away to hear?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.stars.1: Your sky has more lights than ours ever did.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.stars.2: I wonder whether they can see us looking back.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.stars.3: They make the night feel less empty.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.stars.4: If one fell, would you help me return it?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.rain.0: I like the sound of rain when it cannot reach us.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.rain.1: From here it sounds gentle. That is almost unfair.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.rain.2: The whole world changes its voice when it rains.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.rain.3: Let us stay dry and listen for a while.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.rain.4: You call this weather. I call it a very large threat.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.animal.0: It is small... and it is not afraid of me.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.animal.1: It watches everything, even when it pretends not to.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.animal.2: May I come closer, or would that frighten it?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.animal.3: So much life can fit inside such a small body.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.animal.4: I think it likes you. I understand the feeling.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.villager.0: They speak without words. A little like we once did.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.villager.1: They keep watching me when they think I will not notice.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.villager.2: Their home is noisy, but no one seems lonely.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.villager.3: Do all of them understand each other?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.villager.4: I will stand over here. They appear to prefer that.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.held_item.0: What is that? May I look closer?
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.held_item.1: You have something new in your hand.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.held_item.2: What does it do? I promise to be careful.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.held_item.3: The things you carry always have a purpose.
dialogue.faded_pearl.world.held_item.4: May I see it when you are finished?
dialogue.faded_pearl.item_curiosity.0: Thank you. I have never seen it this closely before.
dialogue.faded_pearl.item_curiosity.1: It feels different from how it looked. Here, it is yours.
dialogue.faded_pearl.item_curiosity.2: I think I understand it a little better now.
dialogue.faded_pearl.item_curiosity.3: You trusted me with it. I will remember that.
dialogue.faded_pearl.item_curiosity.4: Interesting... I should give it back before I become too attached.
dialogue.faded_pearl.command.follow.2: Lead the way. I will keep up.
dialogue.faded_pearl.command.stay.1: I will keep watch until you return.
dialogue.faded_pearl.command.stay.2: All right. You know where to find me.
dialogue.faded_pearl.command.rest.0: We can rest here for a while.
dialogue.faded_pearl.command.rest.1: I will sit. Stay if you wish.
dialogue.faded_pearl.command.home.0: I will return to our home.
dialogue.faded_pearl.command.home.2: I will be waiting for you there.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.village.0: So many lives gathered in one place... Is this a village?
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.village.1: Every door here belongs to a different story.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.village.2: They seem wary of me. I will stay close to you.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.player_di: That light came from inside the stone. You found a diamond.
A diamond... Even the darkness could not hide it from you.
You look pleased. I think this one matters.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.enderman_: Wait. There is a blue light behind that stone.
I found something. The rock is hiding a diamond.
Look where I am pointing. Something bright is buried there.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.ender_pea: That pearl... I know the silence inside it.
Please hold it carefully. It once belonged to someone.
Endermen leave so little behind. A pearl remembers more than it shows.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.armor_upg: Your armour is stronger now. I am glad... though I still intend to protect you.
That should keep more of the world away from your skin.
You look ready for danger. I would prefer if danger stayed away.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.tamed_wol: It chose to trust you. May I try to touch its fur someday?
The wolf follows you now. We have something in common.
Its teeth are sharp, but its eyes are gentle beside you.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.tamed_cat: It decided you belong to it. Cats are very confident creatures.
May I stroke it, or must I wait for its permission?
It is small, quiet, and impossible to command. I like it.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.tamed_par: It carries the colours of flowers in its feathers.
Will it repeat my voice too? Perhaps that would be unwise.
It trusts your shoulder. I understand why.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.tamed_oth: It trusts you now. You make frightened creatures feel safe.
May I meet our new companion? I will move slowly.
Another life has chosen to remain beside you.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.pet_anima: It is so small... Do you think it would let me stroke it?
I want to touch its fur, but my hands may frighten it.
May we stay here for a moment? I like watching it.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.build.0: You made all of this from separate pieces. It feels like you.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.build.1: Is it finished? Then let me look at what you have made.
dialogue.faded_pearl.awareness.build.2: You gave this place a shape that did not exist before.
dialogue.faded_pearl.name.learned.1: You gave me a name: %s. I will keep it.
dialogue.faded_pearl.name.learned.2: Then I am %s. I like the way you say it.
dialogue.faded_pearl.name.repeat.2: %s... It sounds warmer in your voice.
dialogue.faded_pearl.name.pet.0: %s trusts you too. I think we will understand each other.
dialogue.faded_pearl.name.pet.1: Hello, %s. I will move gently around you.
dialogue.faded_pearl.name.pet.2: So this little one is %s. I will remember.
hint.faded_pearl.item_curiosity.offer: (Maybe he wants to see what I am holding? I can right-click him.)
tooltip.faded_pearl.enderman_journal: A living record of one shared journey.
tooltip.faded_pearl.enderman_journal.unb: No companion is bound to this copy
screen.faded_pearl.journal.title: Enderman Journal
toast.faded_pearl.journal.title: Enderman Journal
journal.faded_pearl.basic.name: Known name
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.curiosity.u: When he points at an item in my main hand, I can offer him one with right-click. I have a brief moment; then he returns it.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.own_name.us: I can name him with a name tag. In time, he may start responding to its sound.
If I name one of my animals and let them meet, he may address it by name on his own.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.home.use: A Resonating Anchor marks home. The Home command in his menu sends him toward the remembered place.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.commands.us: I crouch and right-click him with an empty main hand to open the command menu: Follow, Stay, Rest or Home.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.carry.use: At enough trust, I right-click him twice with an empty main hand in quick succession. While carried, right-click attempts a safe teleport; Shift lets me dismount.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.rescue.use: He responds on his own when I risk a fall, fire, lava or low health. He must be conscious and have a safe landing spot.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.weather_rea: This is his own response to the weather. I need not give an order; I can watch whether rain or snow can reach him.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.shared_shel: When we wait out rain together under cover, he may react more calmly. The shelter must really keep the rain off him.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.social_repo: At high trust and on Follow, he sometimes chooses another place beside me while we stand somewhere safe.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.animal_carr: He chooses a healthy small animal nearby on his own, including my tamed pets. He will not lift one that is sitting or leashed, and rests between trips.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.escape_pear: I give an Evasion Pearl to my own healed Fade once by right-clicking him with it in my main hand. Its protection is permanent: my strikes deal no damage or trust loss, and each attempt makes him try to evade 8–16 blocks from me. Other players, mobs, and environmental harm still affect him normally.
journal.faded_pearl.recipe.title: Crafting
status.faded_pearl.downed: Downed · up in %s s · right-click to help
toast.faded_pearl.trust_loss.title: −%s ♥ Trust
journal.faded_pearl.basic.loss_hint: A red −♥ shows the actual trust points lost and why.
journal.faded_pearl.basic.care_controls: Crouch and right-click him with an empty main hand to open his menu. When he is downed, right-click to help him stand — no crouching needed. If left alone, he stands after 30 seconds, then slowly recovers health.
journal.faded_pearl.basic.origin.fade_st: One of the few Endermen free of the Ender Dragon's influence. Now I know why my words never vanished into silence beside him: he truly understood them.
journal.faded_pearl.day.meeting.title: Meeting
journal.faded_pearl.day.meeting.text: I found him wounded, huddled in the dark. He reached out with an empty pearl. It weighed almost nothing, yet felt heavy with trust I had not dared to ask for.
journal.faded_pearl.day.healing.title: Healing
journal.faded_pearl.day.healing.text: The Pulsating Pearl shone with the flower's color. I watched his strength return, afraid he would vanish the moment he could. He did not. He chose to stay beside me.
journal.faded_pearl.day.village.title: A village
journal.faded_pearl.day.village.text: Doors creaked in the village, and voices fell quiet as we passed. I felt their eyes on us. He must have felt them too, but he stayed beside me, step for step.
journal.faded_pearl.day.player_diamond.t: When I mined a diamond, I held it up to the light like a little treasure. He looked at the stone, then at me. Perhaps my delight interested him more than its blue gleam.
journal.faded_pearl.day.enderman_diamond: He was the one who spotted the diamond in the stone. He stopped and pointed to a place I would have passed without a thought. This time, I followed his gaze.
journal.faded_pearl.day.ender_pearl.text: When I held an Ender Pearl, his expression grew solemn. I heard something in his voice I could not name. I put it away more carefully than I usually handle precious things.
journal.faded_pearl.day.armor_upgrade.te: My armor is stronger now, and he noticed at once. I touched it, proud of the work behind it. He watched as though still making sure I was safe.
journal.faded_pearl.day.first_tame.title: A new companion
journal.faded_pearl.day.first_tame.text: Today, an animal chose to trust me for the first time. As it came closer, I saw him watching us both. Another bond had begun right before his eyes.
journal.faded_pearl.day.first_build.text: I placed block after block until the scattered pieces became something of my own. When I finished, he stood beside me and looked for a long time. I saw the build differently then.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.curiosity.t: He fixed his gaze on the item in my hand and reached out. I let him borrow one. He turned it over with care, then returned it without a word.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.own_name.te: I spoke his name, and he answered. Sometimes he repeats it quietly afterward, as though learning the sound of something that finally belongs to him.
He called my animal by name. He was not merely echoing the sound: he looked straight at it. I smiled to hear that he had remembered someone else in our little group.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.home.title: Home
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.home.text: I marked a place we could return to. He remembered it. When I say 'home' now, I no longer mean only a point on a map; he knows where to go too.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.commands.te: I asked him for something and watched his behavior change. I did not have to lead him by the hand. He heard my words, then chose his own movement.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.carry.title: Carrying
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.carry.text: He let me climb into his arms. For a while I saw the world from his height as the ground moved beneath us. He held me steady; I trusted him not to let go.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.rescue.text: Danger was close when he suddenly appeared beside me and pulled me beyond its reach. Only when we were safe did I realize how little time I had left.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.weather_rea: The weather changed, and so did his behavior. I looked at the sky, then at him. He did not have to say a word for me to see how much those moments meant to him.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.shared_shel: Rain tapped on the roof while we stood beneath it together. For the first time, I watched him listen calmly to drops that could not reach him.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.social_repo: I had not called him. In the quiet, he walked around me and stopped a little farther on, as if seeking a more comfortable place nearby. That small shift made me feel his presence more keenly.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.animal_carr: He stopped beside a small animal and lifted it gently. For a little while it traveled in his arms, though it had not asked to go. I watched him mind every step, ready to set it back on the ground whenever he needed to.
journal.faded_pearl.behavior.escape_pear: When I struck him, he drew away from me, and I remembered the cold weight of an Ender Pearl. Its energy had always been meant for escape. Perhaps I could seal one safe step inside it — meant for him alone.
